_comment: Goes in the TARGET repo at .pi/models.json.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Until 2026-09-16 the pipeline sent no sampling
parameters at all. Pi only sends them when something defines them, and
OpenRouter does not substitute a default — it omits the parameter upstream
and whichever provider serves the request applies its own. A `:free` model
routes across several providers, so the sampling that produced any given
token was chosen by whoever answered, and a retry can land somewhere else.
That is `NOTES.md` 43, and the leading candidate for the token soup in 38.
`samplingParams` is merged VERBATIM into the request body and its keys win
(`models.md`), so it carries both the sampling AND OpenRouter's top-level
`provider` routing block.
TWO THINGS WERE REMOVED ON 2026-09-16, THE DAY THIS FILE WAS ADDED.
`require_parameters: true` is gone. It restricts routing to providers that
honour every parameter sent, which sounds like exactly what we want — but
on a `:free` variant it can leave ZERO eligible providers, and zero is an
instant error rather than a fallback. The first review run after this file
landed failed three times in three seconds with stopReason=error. That is
not proof it was the cause, and the driver now logs the provider's own
message so the next one will say. Until then the safe default is to ask for
sampling and accept a provider that may not honour all of it.
`top_p` is gone from laguna. OpenRouter's model list does not include top_p
in its supported_parameters at all — sending it was wrong regardless.
No `sort`. Sorting by throughput selects the fastest node, which is also how
you find a heavily quantised one — the opposite of what we are testing.
